name: The war memorial

layers.essential_history: [[c:Oundle's war memorial stands where New Street meets West Street. It was unveiled on 14 November 1920 and cost £600.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:It was listed as a Grade II monument in 1974.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:By the memorial, Martha Pell the carter finds you. She says the extra stone in the Talbot yard isn't hers.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Head north-east, about 140 metres as the crow flies, to St Peter's Church. Head north to the church with the tall spire. Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
